title: bifolium ovatum
intro: Bifolium ovatum, commonly known as the Oval-Leafed Bifolium, is a plant species belonging to the family of flowering plants. It is traditionally used to address various health issues, including fever reduction, pain relief, and inflammation management, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Bifolium ovatum include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids and phenolic acids. These bioactive compounds are responsible for the plant's ability to reduce pain, inflammation, and fever, making it a valuable traditional remedy in folk medicine.
